stock.description: Xinji Shaxi Group Co., Ltd operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the management and operation of commercial centers specializing in hospitality products and home furnishings across the People's Republic of China. The company's portfolio includes five retail complexes: three are dedicated to hospitality supplies, while the other two cater to home decor. Furthermore, the group offers rental services for hospitality provisions, provides exhibition management, and maintains an online retail platform. This enterprise was established in 2002 and its principal offices are located in Guangzhou, China.
